outcome: Neonatal outcomes (preterm birth, low birth weight, stillbirth)
cohort: The study included all teenage pregnant individuals delivering in a large, tertiary maternity hospital in the Republic of Ireland between 2005 and 2022.
finding: Teenage pregnancy rates declined from 3.3% to 1.8% over the study period, while the proportion of Roma mothers significantly increased from 11.5% to 43.5%, with stable obstetric and neonatal outcomes but poor 6-week postnatal clinic attendance.
mod_finding: Delivery outcomes were stable, with higher spontaneous vaginal delivery rates observed in the teenage pregnancy cohort compared to the general obstetric cohort.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome; a general obstetric comparison cohort included infants ≥500 g.
